players.product: medium-voltage switchgear, power control rooms / electrical houses and Remsdaq automation controllers for data-center utility connection (38 kV) and behind-the-meter on-site generation power islands

quarterly_data.signal: Fiscal Q3 revenue $312 million vs $286 million, +9% YoY; gross margin 30.6%; net income $52.2 million or $1.42 per diluted share. Revenue growth 'driven by our commercial and other industrial and electric utility markets'; commercial & other industrial (which includes data center) revenue +54% YoY ($27 million), electric utility +18% ($14 million).
quarterly_data.figure: Q3 revenue $312M (+9% YoY); gross margin 30.6%; EPS $1.42; commercial & other industrial revenue +54%, electric utility +18%

quarterly_data.signal: Record $934 million of new orders in the quarter, 'nearly three times higher than the prior year and nearly double the order total from last quarter'; book-to-bill 3.0x (2.2x fiscal YTD). Backlog reached a record $2.4 billion, $967 million higher than a year ago and $619 million higher sequentially; over $1.8 billion booked over the past three quarters, with awards executing 'deep into our fiscal 2028'.
quarterly_data.figure: record Q3 orders $934M (book-to-bill 3.0x); backlog $2.4B (+$967M YoY); $1.8B booked over past three quarters

quarterly_data.signal: Mega data center order 'in excess of $400 million for Phase 1 of a multi-phase behind the meter design of on-site generation assets', awarded in April. Roughly a two and a half year burn, split across at least five Powell facilities in North America; 'We believe the future phases will be a copy to the job that we just took.' Commercial market now brings mega jobs over $100 million more frequently.
quarterly_data.figure: $400M+ Phase 1 behind-the-meter data center order (April); more commercial mega jobs over $100M

quarterly_data.signal: Backlog mix at quarter end: commercial & other industrial (data center) 40%, electric utility 24%, core industrial (petrochemical, oil & gas) 30% of the $2.4 billion backlog. 'Data center order activity for Powell has clearly inflected higher relative to just one year ago.'
quarterly_data.figure: commercial & other industrial (incl. data center) = 40% of $2.4B backlog; electric utility 24%; oil & gas / petrochemical 30%

quarterly_data.signal: Capacity build-out: Jacintoport expansion adds 335,000 sq ft (completion in the next month or two, 'well in excess of $100 million of incremental annualized revenue' when fully utilized); 50,000 sq ft Houston-area lease (April) and 30,000 sq ft near Ohio; board authorized a ~300,000 sq ft leased manufacturing facility available late fiscal Q2 / early Q3 2027 supported by an $8 million Moseley fabrication investment; a greenfield owned 250,000-300,000 sq ft factory requiring $70 million-$100 million remains under evaluation. Total footprint up over 20% by end of fiscal 2026 vs fiscal 2025.
quarterly_data.figure: Jacintoport +335,000 sq ft (>$100M annualized revenue when fully utilized); ~300,000 sq ft lease facility for fiscal 2027; greenfield option $70M-$100M; footprint +20%

quarterly_data.signal: Backlog conversion: of the $2.4 billion backlog, just under $1.3 billion (roughly 54%) converts over the next 12 months, down from the low 60s because of the large Q3 order slug; project convertibility one to three years; book-and-burn averages about $75 million a quarter. Management expects 'another year of strong financial performance in fiscal 2027'.
quarterly_data.figure: ~$1.3B (54%) of $2.4B backlog convertible in next 12 months; ~$75M/quarter book-and-burn

quarterly_data.signal: Content per data center: both grid-connected and behind-the-meter designs step in at 38 kV, 'very strong market for Powell'; behind-the-meter power islands 'increase the content for Powell from a Switchgear, switches, control, and services total package'. Powell is outside the data center today; the one-megawatt rack is built on DC distribution and the 800 volt design 'is going to happen', a mid-term DC-gear opportunity Powell is evaluating. Remsdaq automation boxes now used in-house for data-center power switching designs.
quarterly_data.figure: 38 kV utility / behind-the-meter connection is Powell's market; 800 V DC in-rack designs a mid-term opportunity

quarterly_data.signal: Balance sheet: $634 million of cash, equivalents and short-term investments at June 30, 2026 (vs $476 million at Sept 30, 2025), no debt; $100 million of operating cash flow in the quarter; Q3 CapEx $6.5 million.
quarterly_data.figure: $634M cash, no debt; Q3 operating cash flow $100M; CapEx $6.5M
